verses.text: For di beginning, God create heaven and di earth.
Di earth no get shape and e dey empty. Darkness dey cover di deep, and God Spirit dey move over di water.
God talk say, “Make light dey,” and light come.
God see di light, say e good. God separate di light from di darkness.
God call di light Day, and di darkness e call Night. Evening come and morning come, na di first day.
God talk say, “Make sky dey between di waters, and make am separate water from water.”
God make di sky, and e separate di waters wey dey under di sky from di waters wey dey above di sky; and e come be so.
God call di sky Heaven. Evening come and morning come, na di second day.
God talk say, “Make di waters wey dey under heaven gather come one place, and make dry land show,” and e come be so.
God call di dry land Earth, and di waters wey gather together e call Seas. God see say e good.
God talk say, “Make di earth bring out grass, plants wey dey carry seed, and fruit trees wey dey bear fruit according to dem kind, wey im seed dey inside, for di earth,” and e come be so.
Di earth bring out grass, plants wey dey carry seed according to dem kind, and trees wey dey bear fruit, wey im seed dey inside, according to dem kind. God see say e good.
Evening come and morning come, na di third day.
God talk say, “Make lights dey for di sky to separate day from night, and make dem be signs, and for seasons, and for days and years;
and make dem be lights for di sky to give light for di earth,” and e come be so.
God make two great lights: di greater light to rule di day, and di lesser light to rule di night. E make di stars too.
God put dem for di sky to give light for di earth,
and to rule over di day and over di night, and to separate di light from di darkness. God see say e good.
Evening come and morning come, na di fourth day.
God talk say, “Make di waters swarm with living creatures, and make birds fly above di earth for di open sky.”
God create di great sea creatures and every living creature wey dey move, wey di waters swarm with, according to dem kind, and every bird wey get wing according to im kind. God see say e good.
God bless dem, talk say, “Una born plenty pikin, increase, and fill di waters for di seas, and make di birds increase for di earth.”
Evening come and morning come, na di fifth day.
God talk say, “Make di earth bring out living creatures according to dem kind: cattle, creeping things, and animals of di earth according to dem kind,” and e come be so.
God make di animals of di earth according to dem kind, di cattle according to dem kind, and everything wey dey creep for di ground according to im kind. God see say e good.

God talk say, “Make we make man for our image, after our likeness. Make dem rule over di fish of di sea, over di birds of di sky, over di cattle, over all di earth, and over every creeping thing wey dey creep for di earth.”
God create man for im own image. For God image e create am. Male and female e create dem.

God bless dem. God talk to dem say, “Una born plenty pikin, increase, fill di earth, and rule am. Rule over di fish of di sea, over di birds of di sky, and over every living thing wey dey move for di earth.”
God talk say, “Look, I don give una every plant wey dey carry seed, wey dey for di face of all di earth, and every tree wey im fruit dey carry seed. Dem go be food for una.
To every animal of di earth, to every bird of di sky, and to everything wey dey creep for di earth, wey get life inside, I don give every green plant for food,” and e come be so.
God see everything wey e make, and look, e very good. Evening come and morning come, na di sixth day.
Di heavens and di earth finish, and everything wey dey inside dem.
For di seventh day God finish im work wey e do, and for di seventh day e rest from all im work wey e do.
God bless di seventh day and make am holy, because for am e rest from all im work wey God create and make.
Dis na di history of di heavens and di earth when dem create dem, for di day wey di Lord God make earth and heaven.
No plant of di field dey for di earth yet, and no herb of di field don grow yet, because di Lord God never send rain for di earth, and no man dey to farm di ground,
but mist dey rise from di earth and e dey water all di surface of di ground.
Di Lord God form man from di dust of di ground, and e blow breath of life enter im nose; and di man become living soul.
Di Lord God plant one garden for Eden, for di east, and for there e put di man wey e form.
Di Lord God make every tree wey fine to look and good for food grow out of di ground, di tree of life too for di middle of di garden, and di tree of di knowledge of good and evil.
One river dey flow out of Eden to water di garden, and from there e divide and become four heads.
Di name of di first na Pishon. Na im dey go round all di land of Havilah, wia gold dey.
Di gold of dat land good. Bdellium and onyx stone dey there.
Di name of di second river na Gihon. Na im dey go round all di land of Cush.
Di name of di third river na Hiddekel. Na im dey flow for di east of Assyria. Di fourth river na Euphrates.
Di Lord God take di man put am inside di garden of Eden to farm am and to keep am.
Di Lord God command di man say, “You fit eat freely from every tree of di garden,
but you no go eat from di tree of di knowledge of good and evil, because for di day wey you eat am, you go surely die.”
Di Lord God talk say, “E no good make di man dey alone. I go make helper wey fit match am.”

Out of di ground di Lord God form every animal of di field and every bird of di sky, and e bring dem to di man to see wetin e go call dem. Whatever di man call every living creature, na im be im name.
Di man give names to all di cattle, to di birds of di sky, and to every animal of di field; but for Adam, dem no find helper wey fit match am.
Di Lord God make Adam fall deep sleep, and e sleep. E take one of im ribs, and close di flesh for there.
Di Lord God build di rib wey e take from di man into woman, and e bring am to di man.
Di man talk say, “Dis one na bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh. Dem go call am woman, because dem take am out of man.”
So man go leave im papa and im mama, and e go join im wife, and dem go become one flesh.
Di man and im wife two dey naked, and dem no dey shame.
Now di serpent wey di Lord God make dey more crafty pass all di animals of di field. E talk to di woman say, “Na true say God talk say, ‘You no go eat from any tree of di garden’?”
Di woman talk to di serpent say, “We fit eat di fruit of di trees of di garden,
but about di fruit of di tree wey dey di middle of di garden, God talk say, ‘Una no go eat am, and una no go touch am, otherwise una go die.’”
Di serpent talk to di woman say, “You no go surely die,
because God know say for di day wey una eat am, una eye go open, and una go be like God, wey know good and evil.”

When di woman see say di tree good for food, and say e fine to look at, and say di tree dey desirable to make person wise, di woman take some of im fruit and eat am. E give some to im husband wey dey with am, and e eat.
Dem two eye open, and dem know say dem dey naked. Dem sew fig leaves join together and make covering for demself.
Dem hear di sound of di Lord God wey dey waka for di garden for di cool of di day, and Adam and im wife hide from di presence of di Lord God among di trees of di garden.
Di Lord God call Adam, talk to am say, “Wia you dey?”
E talk say, “I hear your sound for di garden, and I fear because I dey naked, so I hide.”
E talk say, “Who tell you say you dey naked? You don eat from di tree wey I command you say you no suppose eat?”
Di man talk say, “Di woman wey you give to dey with me, na e give me from di tree, and I eat.”
Di Lord God talk to di woman say, “Wetin be dis wey you don do?” Di woman talk say, “Di serpent deceive me, and I eat.”

Di Lord God talk to di serpent say, “Because you don do dis, you dey cursed pass all cattle, and pass every animal of di field. You go waka on your belly, and you go eat dust all di days of your life.
I go put enmity between you and di woman, and between your seed and im seed. E go bruise your head, and you go bruise im heel.”
To di woman e talk say, “I go greatly increase your pain for childbearing. For pain you go born pikin dem. Your desire go be for your husband, and e go rule over you.”

To Adam e talk say, “Because you listen to your wife voice, and eat from di tree, about wey I command you say, ‘You no go eat from am,’ di ground dey cursed because of you. For pain you go eat from am all di days of your life.
E go bring out thorns and thistles for you, and you go eat di plants of di field.
For di sweat of your face you go eat bread, until you return to di ground, because from am dem take you. You na dust, and to dust you go return.”
Adam call im wife Eve, because e be di mama of all living.
Di Lord God make coats of animal skin for Adam and im wife, and e cloth dem.
Di Lord God talk say, “Look, di man don become like one of us, to know good and evil. Now, make e no stretch out im hand, take from di tree of life too, eat, and live forever.”
So di Lord God send am out of di garden of Eden to farm di ground wey dem take am from.
So e drive di man out; and for di east of di garden of Eden e put cherubim and one flaming sword wey dey turn every way, to guard di way to di tree of life.
Adam know im wife Eve. E become pregnant and born Cain, and talk say, “I don get one man with di help of di Lord.”
E born im brother Abel again. Abel become shepherd, but Cain na farmer.
After some time, Cain bring some of di fruit of di ground as offering to di Lord.
Abel too bring some of di firstborn of im flock and of dem fat. Di Lord respect Abel and im offering,
but e no respect Cain and im offering. Cain vex well well, and im face fall.
Di Lord talk to Cain say, “Why you dey vex? Why your face don fall?
If you do well, you no go dey accepted? If you no do well, sin dey wait for di door, and e want you, but you suppose rule over am.”
Cain talk to im brother Abel say, “Make we go for di field.” E come be say when dem dey for di field, Cain rise up against im brother Abel, and kill am.
Di Lord talk to Cain say, “Wia your brother Abel dey?” E talk say, “I no know. Na me be my brother keeper?”
E talk say, “Wetin you don do? Di voice of your brother blood dey cry to me from di ground.
Now you dey cursed from di ground, wey open im mouth to receive your brother blood from your hand.
When you farm di ground, e no go give you im strength again. You go be fugitive and wanderer for di earth.”
Cain talk to di Lord say, “My punishment too heavy to carry.
Look, you don drive me out today from di surface of di ground. I go hide from your face. I go be fugitive and wanderer for di earth, and whoever find me go kill me.”
Di Lord talk to am say, “Therefore whoever kill Cain, vengeance go come on am seven times.” Di Lord put mark on Cain, so that anyone wey find am no go kill am.
Cain leave di presence of di Lord and stay for di land of Nod, for di east of Eden.
Cain know im wife. E become pregnant and born Enoch. E build one city, and e call di city Enoch, after im pikin name.
Enoch born Irad, Irad born Mehujael, Mehujael born Methushael, and Methushael born Lamech.
Lamech marry two wives: di name of di one na Adah, and di name of di other na Zillah.
Adah born Jabal. Na im be di papa of those wey dey stay for tents and dey keep livestock.
Im brother name na Jubal. Na im be di papa of all wey dey play harp and pipe.
Zillah too born Tubal Cain, wey dey forge every cutting instrument of brass and iron. Tubal Cain sister na Naamah.
Lamech talk to im wives say, “Adah and Zillah, hear my voice. Una wives of Lamech, listen to my speech, because I don kill one man for wounding me, and one young man for hurting me.
If dem go avenge Cain 7 times, truly Lamech go be 77 times.”
Adam know im wife again, and e born one pikin man and call am Seth, talk say, “God don give me another pikin instead of Abel, because Cain kill am.”
To Seth too, one pikin man born, and e call am Enosh. Dat time na im people begin call on di name of di Lord.
Dis na di book of di generations of Adam. For di day wey God create man, e make am for God likeness.
Male and female e create dem, e bless dem, and for di day wey dem create, e call dem Adam.
Adam live 130 years, and e born pikin for im own likeness, after im image, and e call am Seth.
Di days of Adam after e born Seth na 800 years, and e born pikin man dem and pikin woman dem.
All di days wey Adam live na 930 years, and e die.
Seth live 105 years, and e born Enosh.
Seth live 807 years after e born Enosh, and e born pikin man dem and pikin woman dem.
All di days of Seth na 912 years, and e die.
Enosh live 90 years, and e born Kenan.
Enosh live 815 years after e born Kenan, and e born pikin man dem and pikin woman dem.
All di days of Enosh na 905 years, and e die.
Kenan live 70 years, and e born Mahalalel.
Kenan live 840 years after e born Mahalalel, and e born pikin man dem and pikin woman dem.
All di days of Kenan na 910 years, and e die.
Mahalalel live 65 years, and e born Jared.
Mahalalel live 830 years after e born Jared, and e born pikin man dem and pikin woman dem.
All di days of Mahalalel na 895 years, and e die.
Jared live 162 years, and e born Enoch.
Jared live 800 years after e born Enoch, and e born pikin man dem and pikin woman dem.
All di days of Jared na 962 years, and e die.
Enoch live 65 years, and e born Methuselah.
Enoch waka with God after e born Methuselah 300 years, and e born pikin man dem and pikin woman dem.
All di days of Enoch na 365 years.
Enoch waka with God, and e no dey again, because God take am.
Methuselah live 187 years, and e born Lamech.
Methuselah live 782 years after e born Lamech, and e born pikin man dem and pikin woman dem.
All di days of Methuselah na 969 years, and e die.
Lamech live 182 years, and e born one pikin.
E call am Noah, talk say, “Dis one go comfort us concerning our work and di toil of our hands, because of di ground wey di Lord don curse.”
Lamech live 595 years after e born Noah, and e born pikin man dem and pikin woman dem.
All di days of Lamech na 777 years, and e die.
Noah dey 500 years old, and Noah born Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
When men begin to increase for number for di surface of di ground, and pikin woman dem born to dem,
God pikin dem see say di pikin woman dem of men fine, and dem take wives for demself, whoever dem choose.
Di Lord talk say, “My Spirit no go dey struggle with man forever, because e na flesh too. Im days go be 120 years.”

Di Nephilim dey for di earth for those days, and also after dat, when God pikin dem enter di pikin woman dem of men, and dem born pikin for dem. Dem na di mighty men wey dey for old time, di men wey get name.
Di Lord see say di wickedness of man great for di earth, and say every imagination of di thoughts of im heart na only evil all di time.
Di Lord regret say e make man for di earth, and e pain am for im heart.
Di Lord talk say, “I go destroy man wey I create from di surface of di ground, both man, animals, creeping things, and di birds of di sky, because I regret say I make dem.”
But Noah find grace for di eyes of di Lord.
Dis na di history of Noah. Noah na righteous man, and e perfect for im generation. Noah waka with God.
Noah born three pikin: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
Di earth corrupt before God, and di earth full of violence.
God look di earth, and see say e corrupt, because all flesh don corrupt im way for di earth.
God talk to Noah say, “Di end of all flesh don reach me, because di earth full of violence through dem. Look, I go destroy dem with di earth.
Make ark of gopher wood for yourself. Make rooms inside di ark, and cover am inside and outside with pitch.
Dis na how you go make am: di length of di ark go be 300 cubits, im width 50 cubits, and im height 30 cubits.
You go make window for di ark, and finish am to one cubit from di top. Put di door of di ark for im side. You go make am with lower, second, and third decks.
Look, I, even I, go bring flood of waters on di earth, to destroy all flesh wey get breath of life under heaven. Everything wey dey for di earth go die.
But I go establish my covenant with you. You go enter di ark, you, and your pikin dem, and your wife, and your pikin dem wives with you.
Of every living thing of all flesh, two of every kind you go bring enter di ark, to keep dem alive with you. Dem go be male and female.
Of di birds according to dem kind, of di animals according to dem kind, of every creeping thing of di ground according to im kind, two of every kind go come to you, to keep dem alive.
Take some of every food wey dem dey eat for yourself, gather am to you, and e go be food for you and for dem.”
So Noah do am. According to all wey God command am, so e do.
Di Lord talk to Noah say, “Enter di ark, you and all your house, because I don see say you na righteous before me for dis generation.
You go take seven pairs of every clean animal with you, di male and im female. Of di animals wey no clean, two, di male and im female.
Of di birds of di sky too, seven pairs, male and female, to keep seed alive for di surface of all di earth.
For seven days from now, I go cause rain for di earth for 40 days and 40 nights. I go destroy from di surface of di ground every living thing wey I don make.”
Noah do according to all wey di Lord command am.
Noah dey 600 years old when di flood of waters dey for di earth.
Noah enter di ark, and im pikin dem, and im wife, and im pikin dem wives with am, because of di waters of di flood.
Of clean animals, and of animals wey no clean, and of birds, and of everything wey dey creep for di ground,
two by two dem enter come to Noah for di ark, male and female, as God command Noah.
After seven days, di waters of di flood dey for di earth.
For di 600th year of Noah life, for di second month, di 17th day of di month, for di same day all di fountains of di great deep break open, and di windows of heaven open.
Rain dey fall for di earth 40 days and 40 nights.
For di very same day Noah enter di ark, with Shem, Ham, and Japheth, di pikin dem of Noah, and Noah wife, and di three wives of im pikin dem with dem;

dem, and every animal according to im kind, all di cattle according to dem kind, every creeping thing wey dey creep for di earth according to im kind, and every bird according to im kind, every bird of every sort.
Dem come to Noah enter di ark, two by two of all flesh wey get breath of life inside.
Di ones wey enter, enter male and female of all flesh, as God command am; and di Lord shut am in.
Di flood dey for di earth 40 days. Di waters increase, and dem lift up di ark, and e rise above di earth.
Di waters prevail and increase greatly for di earth, and di ark float for di surface of di waters.
Di waters prevail greatly for di earth, and all di high mountains wey dey under di whole sky cover.
Di waters prevail 15 cubits upward, and di mountains cover.
All flesh wey dey move for di earth die, birds, cattle, animals, every creeping thing wey dey creep for di earth, and every man.
Everything wey get breath of life for im nose, of all wey dey for di dry land, die.

E destroy every living thing wey dey for di surface of di ground, man, cattle, creeping things, and birds of di sky. Dem destroy dem from di earth. Only Noah remain, and dem wey dey with am for di ark.
Di waters prevail for di earth 150 days.
God remember Noah, and every living thing, and all di cattle wey dey with am for di ark; and God make wind pass over di earth, and di waters calm down.
Di fountains of di deep and di windows of heaven close, and di rain from heaven stop.
Di waters return from di earth continually. After di end of 150 days, di waters don reduce.
Di ark rest for di seventh month, for di 17th day of di month, for di mountains of Ararat.
Di waters dey reduce continually until di tenth month. For di tenth month, for di first day of di month, di tops of di mountains show.
After 40 days, Noah open di window of di ark wey e make,
and e send out one raven. E go out, going back and forth, until di waters dry up from di earth.
E send out one dove from am, to see if di waters don reduce from di surface of di ground,
but di dove no find place to rest im foot, and e return to am for di ark, because di waters dey for di surface of all di earth. E put out im hand, take am, and bring am into di ark to am.
E wait another seven days, and again e send out di dove from di ark.
Di dove come to am for evening, and look, for im mouth na fresh olive leaf. So Noah know say di waters don reduce from di earth.
E wait another seven days, and send out di dove, and e no return to am again.
For di 601st year, for di first month, di first day of di month, di waters dry up from di earth. Noah remove di covering of di ark, look, and see say di surface of di ground dry.
For di second month, for di 27th day of di month, di earth dry.
God talk to Noah say,
“Go out of di ark, you, and your wife, and your pikin dem, and your pikin dem wives with you.

Bring out with you every living thing wey dey with you of all flesh, birds, cattle, and every creeping thing wey dey creep for di earth, so that dem go multiply for di earth, born plenty pikin, and increase for di earth.”
Noah go out, and im pikin dem, and im wife, and im pikin dem wives with am.
Every animal, every creeping thing, every bird, and whatever dey move for di earth, after dem kind, go out of di ark.
Noah build altar to di Lord, and take some of every clean animal, and of every clean bird, and offer burnt offerings for di altar.

Di Lord smell di pleasing aroma. Di Lord talk for im heart say, “I no go curse di ground again because of man, because di imagination of man heart dey evil from im youth. I no go strike every living thing again, as I don do.
While di earth remain, seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, and day and night no go stop.”
God bless Noah and im pikin dem, talk to dem say, “Una born plenty pikin, increase, and fill di earth.
Di fear of una and di dread of una go dey for every animal of di earth, for every bird of di sky, for all wey dey move for di ground, and for all di fish of di sea. Dem don give dem into una hand.
Every moving thing wey dey live go be food for una. Just as I give una di green plants, I don give una everything.
But flesh with im life, wey be im blood, una no go eat.
Surely I go require your blood of your lives. At di hand of every animal I go require am. At di hand of man, even at di hand of every man brother, I go require di life of man.
Whoever shed man blood, by man go dem shed im blood, because God make man for im own image.
Una, born plenty pikin, and increase. Spread plenty for di earth, and increase for am.”
God talk to Noah and to im pikin dem with am say,
“As for me, look, I dey establish my covenant with una, and with una seed after una,
and with every living creature wey dey with una: di birds, di cattle, and every animal of di earth with una, of all wey go out of di ark, even every animal of di earth.
I go establish my covenant with una. All flesh no go dey cut off again by di waters of di flood. Flood no go dey again to destroy di earth.”
God talk say, “Dis na di sign of di covenant wey I dey make between me and una and every living creature wey dey with una, for perpetual generations:
I don set my rainbow for di cloud, and e go be di sign of di covenant between me and di earth.
When I bring cloud over di earth, di rainbow go show for di cloud,
and I go remember my covenant, wey dey between me and una and every living creature of all flesh. Di waters no go become flood again to destroy all flesh.
Di rainbow go dey for di cloud, and I go look am, so that I go remember di everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh wey dey for di earth.”
God talk to Noah say, “Dis na di sign of di covenant wey I don establish between me and all flesh wey dey for di earth.”
Di pikin dem of Noah wey go out of di ark na Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Ham na di papa of Canaan.
Dis three na di pikin dem of Noah, and from dem all di earth spread.
Noah begin to farm, and e plant vineyard.
E drink some of di wine, and e drunk, and e dey naked inside im tent.
Ham, di papa of Canaan, see im papa nakedness, and tell im two brothers outside.
Shem and Japheth take garment, put am on dem two shoulders, waka backward, and cover dem papa nakedness. Dem faces dey turn backward, and dem no see dem papa nakedness.
Noah wake from im wine, and know wetin im youngest pikin don do to am.
E talk say, “Canaan dey cursed. E go be servant of servants to im brothers.”
E talk say, “Blessed be di Lord, di God of Shem. Make Canaan be im servant.”
“Make God enlarge Japheth, make e dwell for di tents of Shem. Make Canaan be im servant.”
Noah live 350 years after di flood.
All di days of Noah na 950 years, and e die.
Now dis na di generations of di pikin dem of Noah: Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Pikin born to dem after di flood.
Di pikin dem of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
Di pikin dem of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
Di pikin dem of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
From dem di islands of di nations separate for dem lands, everyone according to im language, according to dem families, for dem nations.
Di pikin dem of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
Di pikin dem of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. Di pikin dem of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
Cush born Nimrod. E begin to be mighty for di earth.
E na mighty hunter before di Lord. Dis na why dem dey talk say, “Like Nimrod, mighty hunter before di Lord.”
Di beginning of im kingdom na Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, for di land of Shinar.
Out of dat land e go out to Assyria, and build Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah,
and Resen between Nineveh and Calah. Dat one na di great city.
Mizraim born Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,
Pathrusim, Casluhim, wey di Philistines come from, and Caphtorim.
Canaan born Sidon im firstborn, and Heth,
and di Jebusites, di Amorites, di Girgashites,
di Hivites, di Arkites, di Sinites,
di Arvadites, di Zemarites, and di Hamathites. After dat di families of di Canaanites spread abroad.
Di border of di Canaanites na from Sidon, as you go toward Gerar, reach Gaza; as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, reach Lasha.
Dis na di pikin dem of Ham, after dem families, after dem languages, for dem lands, for dem nations.
To Shem too, di papa of all di pikin dem of Eber, di older brother of Japheth, pikin born.
Di pikin dem of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram.
Di pikin dem of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.
Arpachshad born Shelah. Shelah born Eber.
To Eber two pikin man dem born. Di name of one na Peleg, because for im days di earth divide. Im brother name na Joktan.
Joktan born Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All dis na di pikin dem of Joktan.
Dem dwelling na from Mesha, as you go toward Sephar, di mountain of di east.
Dis na di pikin dem of Shem, after dem families, after dem languages, for dem lands, after dem nations.
Dis na di families of di pikin dem of Noah, after dem generations, for dem nations. From dem di nations spread for di earth after di flood.
